title: Surreal Portrait Collage
description: A central portrait of a middle-aged man wearing a camouflage cap and green jacket is superimposed over a surreal composite landscape. The scene includes a stormy ocean with large waves on the left, a blue cartoon-style fish with large eyes on the right, colorful pottery on a foreground table, tall green reeds, purple and blue clouds, and a reflective lake with distant trees in the background.
prompt: Surreal composite painting featuring a realistic middle-aged man in a camouflage cap and green jacket at center, blended into a dreamlike landscape with a turbulent blue ocean and waves on the left, a worried blue cartoon fish character on the right, colorful abstract pottery and vases in the foreground, tall green reeds, floating purple and blue clouds, and a calm reflective lake with distant trees under a dramatic sky.
